name: Webtop (Docker)
description: Full Linux desktop (XFCE, KDE, MATE, i3...) in the browser using the official LinuxServer.io Webtop image with the Selkies streaming stack: audio, microphone, clipboard, file transfers and hardware-friendly codecs out of the box. Docker-based variant of the Webtop script, easier to keep up to date.

notes.text: Uses Docker inside the LXC on purpose (official lscr.io/linuxserver/webtop image) to make maintenance trivial: updates are a 'docker compose pull && up -d'. Use the 'webtop' script for the bare-metal, Docker-free variant.

The desktop terminal has passwordless sudo and the container can reach your LAN. Built-in HTTP basic auth is only adequate for a trusted LAN: for public exposure put a reverse proxy with real authentication (Authentik, Authelia, OAuth2 proxy) in front of it.

Port 3001 serves HTTPS with a self-signed certificate (HTTPS is required for audio/video). When proxying with Nginx Proxy Manager use scheme https and 'proxy_ssl_verify off', with WebSocket support enabled.

Settings live in /opt/webtop-docker/.env: add any SELKIES_*, LC_ALL (e.g. it_IT.UTF-8) or HARDEN_DESKTOP option there and run 'docker compose up -d' in /opt/webtop-docker. The desktop home (/config) is persisted in /opt/webtop-docker/config.
The debian-xfce/ubuntu-xfce flavors ship Chromium as the web browser, not Firefox. 'latest' is Alpine XFCE.
The image is published for arm64 too, but arm64 has not been verified in this repository yet, so the CT script leaves var_arm64 unset.
